The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azamin]] maintained a '''stronghold''' during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Codex" /> Around [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">{{TORcite|type=codex|Darth Decimus}} states that [[Darth Azamin]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] near the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], which ''[[Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant]]'' places in [[3653 BBY]].</ref> Azamin's rival [[Darth Decimus]] arranged for<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> a [[Jedi strike team (Assassination of Darth Azamin)|Jedi strike team]] to infiltrate the stronghold and [[Assassination of Darth Azamin|successfully assassinate]] Azamin, although the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Death/Legends|perished]] in their escape when their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] exploded.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Azamin's stronghold was mentioned in the Codex entry for Darth Decimus in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
